title: Thursday · Nevermoor, library, maths, PE and Spaces / Bloxels
arrival: Settle in and answer attendance before handing in forms. Get ready for Nevermoor before library.
note: Teacher-confirmed Thursday sequence: Nevermoor before library; maths work or reading after library; discuss Friday plans and prepare for PE after recess; Spaces / Bloxels after lunch and quiet time. Preserve library 9:20–9:35, snack 10:20, recess 10:35–10:50, PE 11:10–11:50, lunch 11:50–12:35 and dismissal 2:35. Continue from actual learning and reading stopping points. Halloween colouring is an optional work-time choice, not a new assignment or deadline. Confirm only known Friday arrangements; do not invent event details. Device access, successful logins and uploads are not assumed.

blocks.title: Arrival and attendance
blocks.notes: Attendance before form collection. Preview the Thursday plan.
studentSteps: Answer attendance, then hand in any forms.
Look at today’s plan and get ready for Nevermoor.

blocks.title: Nevermoor · read, listen and respond
blocks.notes: Find the actual book or audio bookmark and briefly recall only the last part actually read. Do not assume a chapter or story event. Read or listen, then say, draw or write an idea supported by a character or setting detail. Mark the new stopping point before library.
blocks.firstAction: Find where our class actually stopped in Nevermoor and get ready to listen or read.
studentSteps: Listen or read from our actual stopping point.
Notice one character or setting detail.
Say, draw or write an idea and the detail that supports it.
Mark where we stop and keep one question for next time.
blocks.firstActionKo: 지난번에 읽다가 멈춘 곳을 찾고 이야기를 듣거나 읽을 준비를 하세요.

blocks.title: Prepare for library
blocks.notes: Save the actual reading bookmark and allow a calm transition to library.
blocks.firstAction: Mark our Nevermoor stopping point and get your library book.
blocks.firstActionKo: 읽다가 멈춘 곳을 표시하고 도서관 책을 준비하세요.

blocks.title: Library · book exchange
blocks.notes: Established Thursday book exchange; return to class by 9:35.
blocks.firstAction: Bring your library book and follow the exchange routine.
blocks.firstActionKo: 도서관 책을 가져오고 정해진 순서대로 반납과 대출을 하세요.

blocks.title: Maths work block / reading
blocks.notes: Continue the maths task actually underway, or reading as directed. Check the actual stopping point rather than assuming a planned lesson was completed. Offer Halloween colouring as an optional work-time choice; no new deadline.
blocks.firstAction: Get out the maths work or reading your teacher selects.
studentSteps: Find your actual stopping point.
Work on the selected next step and ask for help when needed.
Check your progress before snack.
blocks.firstActionKo: 선생님이 정한 수학 활동이나 읽을 책을 준비하세요.

blocks.title: Snack
blocks.firstAction: Have your snack and tidy your space.

blocks.title: Friday plans and prepare for PE
blocks.notes: Discuss confirmed plans for Friday and answer questions. Keep unconfirmed event details and individual arrangements off the public plan. Allow time to put materials away and prepare for PE.
blocks.firstAction: Listen to the confirmed Friday plan and get ready for PE.
studentSteps: Listen and ask a question if something is unclear.
Put materials away.
Follow the directions for getting ready for PE.
blocks.firstActionKo: 확정된 금요일 계획을 듣고 체육 수업을 준비하세요.

blocks.title: Physical and Health Education · gym
blocks.notes: Use the scheduled Thursday PE block. Teacher selects a familiar activity suited to the actual space and equipment. Review safety and fair participation, warm up, practise and play, then cool down. Do not assume a particular game or equipment is booked.
blocks.firstAction: Listen to the safety directions and choose a way to join.
studentSteps: Follow the warm-up and practise the movement your teacher selects.
Help everyone get an active turn.
Name one action that helped the group.
blocks.firstActionKo: 안전 수칙을 듣고 참여할 방법을 고르세요.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.notes: Usual intermediate routine: outside 11:50–12:12; transition 12:12–12:13; eating 12:13–12:35.
blocks.firstAction: Follow our outside-play and lunch routine.
blocks.firstActionKo: 바깥 놀이와 점심시간에는 정해진 순서대로 하세요.

blocks.title: Quiet reset
blocks.notes: Keep this a brief calm transition after lunch. Quiet non-reading choices are available. Prepare for Spaces / Bloxels time.
blocks.firstAction: Choose quiet reading, drawing or a calm seated activity.
blocks.firstActionKo: 조용히 책 읽기, 그림 그리기, 자리에 앉아서 쉬기 중 하나를 고르세요.

blocks.title: Spaces / Bloxels time
blocks.notes: After quiet time, continue teacher-selected Spaces / Bloxels work already underway. Check device and login access before starting. Model the next step using the actual task, and help students save their progress. Posting or uploading is only as specifically directed and must follow school privacy expectations; do not assume uploads are required or complete. If access is unavailable, plan or continue the same work on paper. Optional Halloween colouring remains available during work time.
blocks.firstAction: Listen for your Spaces / Bloxels task and check what you need to continue.
studentSteps: Open only the task your teacher selects, or use the paper alternative.
Continue one manageable next step.
Save your progress and show or explain what you worked on.
blocks.firstActionKo: 선생님이 안내하는 Spaces / Bloxels 활동과 필요한 준비물을 확인하세요.

blocks.title: Planners, jobs and cleanup
blocks.notes: Keep routine cleanup around 2:00; move unfinished learning forward.
blocks.firstAction: Restore our room and record any confirmed reminders.
blocks.firstActionKo: 교실을 정리하고 확정된 안내 사항을 적으세요.

blocks.title: Classroom community
blocks.notes: Use a short check-in, appreciation or familiar cooperative game. Students may speak, draw, point or pass. Name a small next step for tomorrow.
blocks.firstAction: Notice one helpful action from today.
studentSteps: Offer one specific appreciation or listen.
Name a small next step for our next school day.
blocks.firstActionKo: 오늘 도움이 된 행동 한 가지를 떠올려 보세요.

blocks.title: Pack up and dismissal
blocks.firstAction: Check your belongings and get ready for a calm departure.
blocks.firstActionKo: 자기 물건을 확인하고 차분히 하교할 준비를 하세요.

backups: If devices or logins are unavailable, plan the selected Spaces / Bloxels work on paper. Do not assume a posting is required.
Halloween colouring is an optional work-time choice, not a new assignment or deadline.
Continue Nevermoor from the actual bookmark and maths from the actual class stopping point.
Discuss only confirmed Friday arrangements. Carry unfinished work forward without inventing a deadline.
